plugins.name: afk
plugins.description: A help router plus a coding flow: prototype (throwaway logic/UI exploration) → grill (relentless plan interview, docs-aware) → implement (lead plans, workers run bounded TDD slices) → simplify (parallel cleanup) → qa (frontend/backend evidence verification). Plus a persistent brain/ memory vault the flow reads before acting and writes back to as it learns.
